hooks.command: file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == *.md ]]; then chars=$(wc -c < "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "[hooks] 写入完成: $(basename "$file") — ${chars} 字节"; fi
file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == *.json ]] || [[ "$file" == *.ttl ]] || [[ "$file" == *.owl ]]; then echo "[hooks] 本体/数据文件已更新: $(basename "$file")"; fi

Stop.command: echo "[hooks] 会话结束 - 统一领域模型(CIM)写作项目"
